title: Credential
description: A declared credential anchored to the public register of the institution that issued it — a license, certification, or permit the SELLER holds and declares, and any reader verifies against that institution's own record. The clause names no institution, so one agreement accommodates every issuer: each seller declares on its profile the register of the institution that issued its own credential (a URI template whose {id} placeholder substitutes the declared identifier), the credential's name, and its identifier in that register, and checkout folds all three onto the committed leaf. The register — the issuing institution's public record, distinct from the protocol's on-chain registries — is the source of truth: the clause references it, it does not restate, fetch, or interpret it. Verification is the reader's act at read time (a per-leaf affordance opens the substituted register URL); nothing gates signing, and no verification status is stored — the bond prices a false or lapsed declaration, and the committed claim is timestamped evidence for the composed recourse layer. An example of a register a seller may declare, never a default: https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/xjfq-wh2d.json?license_number={id} (the NYC TLC active for-hire drivers register).

fields.name: credentialRegisterUri
fields.label: Issuing institution's register (URI template)
fields.description: The public register of the institution that issued the seller's credential, as a URI template with an {id} placeholder for the declared identifier. Declared by the seller on its profile and folded onto the leaf at checkout; no agreement names the institution. The register is the institution's own record; the protocol never mirrors or interprets it.

fields.name: credentialTitle
fields.label: Credential
fields.description: Human-readable name of the credential the register attests (e.g. "NYC TLC For-Hire Vehicle Driver License"). Declared by the seller on its profile beside the register; labels drawers and derived documents.

fields.name: credentialId
fields.label: Declared identifier
fields.description: The seller's declared identifier in the issuing institution's register (e.g. a TLC license number). Declared once on the seller's profile and folded onto the leaf at checkout; substituted into the register template's {id} for verification by any reader.
